t: This Act shall become effective at the beginning of the quarter following the date of enactment.

fable.w: The section only sets the effective date of the Act. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.

qwen_block.s: This Act shall become effective at the beginning of the quarter following the date of enactment.
